summary: Reproduced the Forward Pass Metrics crash in the checked-out implementation when a pure decode batch has seq_lens_cpu=None, then made decode metrics fall back to req.seqlen. Added regression coverage through the emitting path plus populated-mirror and empty-batch boundary cases. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/31319 is open with the same fallback concept, but the prepared main base did not contain it.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the FPM emit path raised TypeError at metrics_reporter.py while iterating a decode batch whose seq_lens_cpu was None; the populated seq_lens_cpu boundary passed. Raw output: reports/j-3ec386bb146b/failing-before.log

Passing-after validation of all 21 Forward Pass Metrics unit tests, including fallback count/sum/population variance, preservation of the populated CPU mirror, and an empty decode batch. Raw output: reports/j-3ec386bb146b/passing-after.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect is CPU-side observability aggregation before publication and was deterministically reproduced in the real SchedulerMetricsReporter emit path without executing a GPU kernel. No GPU result is claimed.

remaining_limitations: The original 8x NVIDIA B200, GLM-5.1, NSA/TRTLLM, DP-attention distributed deployment was unavailable; no full-model or multi-node reproduction is claimed.
The assigned single gfx950 cannot reproduce the report's multi-rank NVIDIA/Gloo failure cascade, and GPU execution is not needed to exercise the faulty metrics aggregation branch.
The prepared Python environment does not contain the ruff module, so ruff checks were unavailable; git diff --check passed.
No native code changed and no native rebuild was applicable.
